comment: The recorder (scripts/record-session.mjs recordSegment()) launches C as "nethack -u <name>", taking <name> from the first OPTIONS name: value after JavaScript trim(), which removes Unicode white space: here an ideographic space (U+3000) before the name and a no-break space (U+00A0) after it. sys/unix/unixmain.c process_options() (385-396) runs after initoptions() and copies that argument over the name the nethackrc set, so C plays as 'Hayato' and the welcome message, the status line and the ^X attribute screen show it without the spaces (js/unixmain.js parseNethackrcName(), process_options()).
